title.en: AMD agrees to acquire World Labs for approximately $8.2 billion
title.zhHans: AMD 同意以约 82 亿美元收购 World Labs

searchSummary.en: AMD entered a definitive all-stock agreement to acquire Fei-Fei Li-led World Labs for approximately $8.2 billion, subject to regulatory approval and customary closing conditions.
searchSummary.zhHans: AMD 签署最终全股票协议，拟以约 82 亿美元收购李飞飞领导的 World Labs；交易仍需监管批准并满足惯常交割条件。

summary.en: AMD entered a definitive all-stock agreement to acquire Fei-Fei Li-led World Labs for approximately $8.2 billion, subject to regulatory approval and customary closing conditions.
summary.zhHans: AMD 签署最终全股票协议，拟以约 82 亿美元收购李飞飞领导的 World Labs；交易仍需监管批准并满足惯常交割条件。

narrative.en: The agreement would bring a major world-model research team into a semiconductor and AI-compute company. It remains an announced transaction rather than a completed ownership change, so integration benefits and market effects are not counted as observed impacts.
narrative.zhHans: 该协议拟将重要的世界模型研究团队纳入半导体与 AI 算力公司体系。交易目前仍处于公告阶段，并未完成所有权变更，因此整合收益和市场影响不计为已观察影响。

text.en: AMD entered a definitive agreement to acquire World Labs in an all-stock transaction valued at approximately $8.2 billion.
text.zhHans: AMD 签署最终协议，拟以约 82 亿美元的全股票交易收购 World Labs。

text.en: The acquisition had not closed by the evidence cutoff and remained subject to regulatory approvals and customary conditions.
text.zhHans: 截至证据截止日，该收购尚未完成，仍需监管批准并满足惯常条件。
